notes.title: Ver. 1.01 Now Available!
notes.notes:
[b]This patch adds vibration support for DS4/Xinput controllers.[/b]

If the vibration feature is not working for you, go the "Properties" menu for SENRAN KAGURA Reflexions in your library and change the "Steam Input Per-Game Setting" option in the GENERAL tab to "Use your global Steam Input Settings."
